name: vigueur
description: Reliable access to French law for Claude: Légifrance and Judilibre through your own PISTE credentials, running locally.

piste_client_id.title: PISTE client ID
piste_client_id.description: OAuth client ID of your PISTE application (free account on https://piste.gouv.fr). No account yet? See https://github.com/me-no-code/vigueur-mcp/blob/main/user-docs/en/10-setup/01-piste-account.md

piste_client_secret.title: PISTE client secret
piste_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret of the same PISTE application. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

piste_env.title: PISTE environment
piste_env.description: Must match the application the credentials belong to: sandbox for the application PISTE creates automatically, production for one you created.
